verdict.rationale: kitty's own docs say it supports startup sessions to specify working environments, along with programmable tabs, splits and multiple layouts (Stack, Tall, Grid, Splits). Scripts can also drive window creation through remote control. A hands-on user confirms default startup tabs are easy to set up via session files. Missing for 10: detailed first-party evidence of session-file syntax and one-command launch, and better session-file argument documentation (a user called it barely documented).
